method: Assistant visual inspection of all ten candidate CGs against own locked portraits and backgrounds. Eight accepted; two rejected and removed from playable images.
notes: All accepted CGs are landscape 1200x896, softly painted with thin contours and the established muted palette.
Nina keeps one ash-blonde right-shoulder braid, fair skin and own face; Artyom retains medium-brown skin, black curls and short black beard/moustache.
Indoor scenes use the locked jumpers; work jackets only outdoors. Sonya retains cropped straight dark hair/mustard fleece; Pavel grey hair/stubble and grey-green work jacket.
Music uses two separate wired in-ear pairs, consistent with prose saying headphones; no shared single earphone.
Walk uses a dry safe trail and stowed camera; kiss is gentle and mutually welcomed, no camera/strap worn.
Sensor focuses on Nina fastening a recorder to a simple support; Artyom waits in the background, camera lowered.
No readable lettering, logos or UI strips observed. Rejected candidates are NOT approved or counted as completed art.
